metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Security Property Catalog
metadata.description: Comprehensive catalog of formal security properties with 100% coverage of all nodes and edges in the Program Graph. Each graph element has at least one associated property with formal reachability analysis.

properties.property: STATE-USER-IDLE represents an untrusted actor with no active protocol engagement. Any actions initiated from this state must be validated before affecting trusted contract state.
properties.anti_property: An action initiated from STATE-USER-IDLE bypasses input validation and directly modifies trusted contract state.
properties.reachability_rationale: All paths from STATE-USER-IDLE to trusted contract states pass through validation actions. The graph structure enforces that user-initiated edges lead to contract validation nodes before state changes.
properties.notes: Initial user state - all user actions require crossing trust boundaries.

properties.property: STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING indicates user holds underlying ERC20 tokens. Only wrap() operations can transition tokens into the zERC20 system.
properties.anti_property: A user can acquire zERC20 tokens without providing equivalent underlying tokens.
properties.reachability_rationale: The path from STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING to STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 must pass through ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY which uses transferFrom to pull underlying tokens. Minting without pulling is not possible in the graph.
properties.notes: Enforced by LiquidityManager's wrap() function requiring successful transferFrom.

properties.property: STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 can only be reached via legitimate wrap operations or valid teleport proofs. The state represents authentic zERC20 holdings.
properties.anti_property: A user reaches STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 with tokens that were not backed by underlying collateral or valid proofs.
properties.reachability_rationale: Only two paths lead to zERC20 ownership: (1) STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE after successful wrap, (2) STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE after verified zkSNARK proof. Both paths enforce collateralization or cryptographic validity.
properties.notes: Fundamental solvency invariant of the protocol.

properties.property: STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP is a trusted contract state that processes wrap requests with amount validation before minting.
properties.anti_property: A wrap request bypasses STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP and directly triggers minting without amount validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: The graph shows all wrap operations must enter through STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP before proceeding to reward calculation and minting. No bypass path exists.
properties.notes: Entry point for wrap flow in LiquidityManager.

properties.property: ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-REWARD correctly computes incentive curve rewards using IncentiveLib with proper rounding (floor for rewards).
properties.anti_property: An attacker can manipulate reward calculation to receive more than the mathematically correct incentive amount.
properties.reachability_rationale: The reward calculation uses deterministic IncentiveLib functions with floor rounding. No user input directly affects the calculation beyond the wrap amount, which is bounded.
properties.notes: Implementation correctness relies on IncentiveLib mathematical soundness.

properties.property: ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY executes transferFrom for the exact wrap amount. Liquidity is pulled before any zERC20 is minted.
properties.anti_property: zERC20 tokens are minted before underlying liquidity is successfully pulled, enabling fund extraction.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge from ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY to ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20 is the only path to minting. transferFrom must succeed (not revert) before the edge is traversed.
properties.notes: Checks-effects-interactions pattern should be used to prevent reentrancy.

properties.property: ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20 mints exactly (amount + reward) where reward is calculated via IncentiveLib. Only authorized minter can call mint().
properties.anti_property: An unauthorized entity can invoke minting, or the minted amount differs from (wrap amount + calculated reward).
properties.reachability_rationale: The onlyMinter modifier on zERC20.mint() restricts minting to LiquidityManager. The graph shows minting only occurs after successful liquidity pull.
properties.notes: Minter authorization is critical - single point of control.

properties.property: STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE is only reachable after successful liquidity pull and minting. A Wrapped event is emitted.
properties.anti_property: STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE is reached without underlying tokens being locked in the protocol.
properties.reachability_rationale: The only path to STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE is from ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20, which follows ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY. The sequential nature prevents bypass.
properties.notes: Terminal state for successful wrap operations.

properties.property: STATE-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP validates the user has sufficient zERC20 balance and requests unwrap amount.
properties.anti_property: A user can initiate unwrap for more zERC20 than they own, or unwrap without holding any zERC20.
properties.reachability_rationale: The unwrap function checks balance before proceeding. The edge from STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 to STATE-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP requires the user to actually hold tokens.
properties.notes: Balance check is implicit in ERC20 transferFrom/burn operations.

properties.property: ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE computes unwrap fee using IncentiveLib with ceiling rounding (protocol never undercollects).
properties.anti_property: An attacker can manipulate fee calculation to pay less than the mathematically correct fee amount.
properties.reachability_rationale: Fee calculation is deterministic based on current liquidity state and unwrap amount. Ceiling rounding protects protocol from underpayment.
properties.notes: Fee calculation must check for sufficient liquidity availability.

properties.property: ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20 burns the exact unwrap amount from user. Burn must complete before underlying transfer.
properties.anti_property: Underlying tokens are transferred before zERC20 is burned, enabling double-spend via reentrancy.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge order in the graph (burn -> transfer) enforces burn-before-transfer. Proper checks-effects-interactions prevents reentrancy exploitation.
properties.notes: Reentrancy guard or CEI pattern required in implementation.

properties.property: ACTION-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING sends exactly (amount - fee) underlying tokens to user after burn.
properties.anti_property: User receives more underlying than (burned amount - calculated fee).
properties.reachability_rationale: Transfer amount is computed as (unwrap amount - fee). The fee is ceiling-rounded, ensuring user never receives excess.
properties.notes: Final step of unwrap - must occur after burn.

properties.property: STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE indicates successful burn and underlying transfer. An Unwrapped event is emitted.
properties.anti_property: STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE is reached without zERC20 being burned.
properties.reachability_rationale: The only path to STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE passes through ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20. No bypass exists.

properties.property: STATE-UNWRAP-FAILED-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY is reached when requested amount exceeds available liquidity (underlyingBalance - feeSurplus).
properties.anti_property: Unwrap succeeds despite insufficient liquidity, leading to insolvency.
properties.reachability_rationale: The fee calculation action checks liquidity availability. If insufficient, the EDGE-UNWRAP-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY is taken instead of proceeding.
properties.notes: Solvency protection - protocol cannot pay out more than it holds.

properties.property: STATE-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER receives transfer requests for validation. Value constraint check follows.
properties.anti_property: A transfer bypasses STATE-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER and directly modifies balances.
properties.reachability_rationale: All transfer() calls enter the zERC20 contract at this state. The _afterTokenTransfer hook enforces validation.
properties.notes: Entry point for standard ERC20 transfers.

properties.property: ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE enforces value <= 2^248-1 for BN254 scalar field compatibility.
properties.anti_property: A transfer with value > 2^248-1 succeeds, corrupting the hash chain with values outside the scalar field.
properties.reachability_rationale: The _afterTokenTransfer hook reverts with ValueTooLarge if the constraint is violated. No path to balance update exists for oversized values.

properties.property: ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-BALANCES only executes after value validation passes. Balance updates are atomic.
properties.anti_property: Balance update occurs with an invalid value or partial update leaves inconsistent state.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-BALANCES only exists from ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE success path. Failed validation leads to revert.

properties.property: ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN appends (to, value) to SHA-256 hash chain deterministically. Hash chain is monotonically extended.
properties.anti_property: An attacker can modify the hash chain to exclude transfers or include fabricated transfers.
properties.reachability_rationale: The hash chain update is deterministic based on transfer data. Only valid transfers (post-validation) reach this action. Preimage resistance of SHA-256 prevents fabrication.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: SHA-256 preimage resistance, truncated to 248 bits

properties.property: ACTION-ZERC20-EMIT-INDEXED-TRANSFER emits IndexedTransfer event with monotonically increasing index.
properties.anti_property: Indexed transfer events are emitted out of order or with duplicate/skipped indices.
properties.reachability_rationale: The index counter is incremented atomically with each transfer. Solidity's atomicity guarantees sequential indices within single-threaded execution.
properties.notes: Event ordering is critical for Merkle tree construction by Indexer.

properties.property: STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE indicates all transfer steps (validation, balance update, hash chain, event) completed successfully.
properties.anti_property: STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE is reached with incomplete hash chain update or missing event.
properties.reachability_rationale: The sequential edge structure ensures all four actions complete before reaching this terminal state. Transaction atomicity prevents partial completion.

properties.property: STATE-TRANSFER-REJECTED-VALUE-TOO-LARGE correctly prevents transfers exceeding 2^248-1.
properties.anti_property: A transfer is rejected incorrectly for a valid value, or accepted incorrectly for an oversized value.
properties.reachability_rationale: The validation check is a simple comparison (value <= MAX_VALUE). The edge to rejection only fires on exceeded constraint.
properties.notes: Failure path protects ZK circuit integrity.

properties.property: STATE-VERIFIER-IDLE represents the Verifier contract ready to process hash chain reservations, proofs, and teleports.
properties.anti_property: Verifier processes requests while in an invalid or compromised state.
properties.reachability_rationale: The Verifier's state is managed by contract logic. Recovery from emergency returns to idle only via proper admin action.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-RESERVE-HASH-CHAIN reads the current hash chain state from trusted zERC20 contract and stores checkpoint.
properties.anti_property: A reserved checkpoint contains attacker-controlled data instead of authentic zERC20 hash chain state.
properties.reachability_rationale: The Verifier reads hashChain directly from the trusted zERC20 contract address, not from user input. No path allows user-supplied hash chain values.

properties.property: STATE-HASH-CHAIN-RESERVED indicates a valid checkpoint is stored and available as public input for Nova proofs.
properties.anti_property: A proof is submitted using a non-existent or invalid checkpoint.
properties.reachability_rationale: Proof submission checks that the referenced checkpoint index exists in reservedHashChains mapping before validation.
properties.notes: Checkpoint existence check is prerequisite for proof validation.

properties.property: STATE-AWAITING-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROOF indicates system is ready to receive and validate Nova transfer root proofs.
properties.anti_property: A transfer root proof is processed without an associated reserved checkpoint.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge EDGE-AWAITING-NOVA-PROOF only exists from STATE-HASH-CHAIN-RESERVED. No path to proof validation without prior checkpoint.
properties.notes: Sequential dependency enforced by graph structure.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF verifies the Nova proof via IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof() using reserved checkpoint as public input.
properties.anti_property: An invalid Nova proof is accepted, allowing a false transfer root to be stored.
properties.reachability_rationale: The IRootDecider performs cryptographic verification. Invalid proofs fail verification and trigger revert. Mathematical soundness of Groth16 prevents forgery.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Groth16 zkSNARK verification with BN254 pairing
properties.notes: Core security property - proof soundness is fundamental.

properties.property: STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED is only reachable via successful Nova proof verification. Proved roots are stored in provedTransferRoots mapping.
properties.anti_property: A transfer root is stored without valid proof verification.
properties.reachability_rationale: The only edge to STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED is EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-VALID from successful verification. Failed verification leads to revert or emergency.
properties.notes: Critical state transition guarded by cryptographic verification.

properties.property: STATE-EMERGENCY-TRIGGERED is reached only when divergent proofs are detected for the same index (different roots for same checkpoint).
properties.anti_property: Emergency is triggered incorrectly for valid proofs, causing denial of service.
properties.reachability_rationale: Divergent proof detection compares newly proved root against existing stored root at same index. Only true divergence triggers emergency.

properties.property: STATE-AWAITING-TELEPORT-PROOF indicates the Verifier is ready to process teleport requests with withdrawal proofs.
properties.anti_property: A teleport request is processed without proper root reference validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: The teleport flow requires sequential validation: root reference -> recipient hash -> monotonicity -> withdrawal proof. No shortcut exists.
properties.notes: Entry point for teleport withdrawal flow.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE checks that the proof's root exists in provedTransferRoots (local) or globalTransferRoots (cross-chain).
properties.anti_property: A teleport references a non-existent or fabricated root that passes validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Root lookup in storage mappings returns zero for non-existent keys. Comparison with user-provided root fails for fabricated values.
properties.notes: Root existence is prerequisite for teleport validity.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH verifies that the on-chain recipient matches the hash committed in the proof's public inputs.
properties.anti_property: An attacker redirects teleport funds to an address different from the one in the proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: The recipient hash is a public input to the proof. On-chain verification computes hash of claimed recipient and compares. Mismatch causes revert.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Hash binding of recipient in zkSNARK public inputs

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY enforces strictly increasing totalTeleported to prevent double-spend of the same proof.
properties.anti_property: A proof can be replayed multiple times, each time minting tokens (double-spend).
properties.reachability_rationale: The proof's new totalTeleported must be strictly greater than stored value. Replay would have equal or lesser value, causing revert.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF cryptographically verifies the Nova or Groth16 withdrawal proof.
properties.anti_property: An invalid withdrawal proof is accepted, minting tokens without valid burn proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: Proof verification uses the appropriate decider (withdrawLocal or withdrawGlobal). Invalid proofs fail pairing check. Mathematical soundness prevents forgery.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Groth16 zkSNARK soundness with BN254 pairing

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT only executes after all validation steps pass. Calls zERC20.teleport() with exact delta amount.
properties.anti_property: teleport() is called with an amount different from the proof's delta, or without all validations.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge EDGE-PROOF-VALID-CALL-TELEPORT only exists from successful withdrawal proof validation. Amount delta is extracted from verified proof public inputs.
properties.notes: Final step before minting - all validations must pass.

properties.property: STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE indicates successful privacy-preserving transfer with valid proof verification and token minting.
properties.anti_property: STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE is reached without all four validation steps (root, recipient, monotonicity, proof).
properties.reachability_rationale: The graph enforces sequential validation. STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE is only reachable via EDGE-TELEPORT-MINTED from ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT, which requires all prior validations.

properties.property: STATE-TELEPORT-REJECTED correctly catches invalid root references, recipient mismatches, double-spend attempts, and invalid proofs.
properties.anti_property: A valid teleport is incorrectly rejected, causing denial of service for legitimate users.
properties.reachability_rationale: Each validation step has specific failure conditions. Only actual failures lead to rejection. Deterministic validation prevents false rejections.
properties.notes: Failure state with multiple incoming edges from validation failures.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-RELAY-ROOT sends proved transfer root to Hub via LayerZero after successful proof verification.
properties.anti_property: An unproved or fabricated root is relayed to Hub as if it were legitimately proved.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge to ACTION-VERIFIER-RELAY-ROOT only exists from STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED. Relaying requires prior successful proof verification.
properties.notes: Cross-chain message originates from trusted Verifier.

properties.property: STATE-ROOT-RELAYED indicates the transfer root has been submitted to LayerZero for cross-chain delivery.
properties.anti_property: A relay message is lost or corrupted during LayerZero transmission without protocol awareness.
properties.reachability_rationale: LayerZero message delivery is semi-trusted (13/19 guardian consensus). Message corruption/loss is theoretically possible but mitigated by retry mechanisms and guardian integrity.

properties.property: STATE-HUB-IDLE represents Hub contract ready to receive transfer roots from registered Verifiers.
properties.anti_property: Hub processes roots from unregistered or unauthorized sources.
properties.reachability_rationale: The _lzReceive callback validates source EID against registered Verifier list before processing. Unauthorized sources are rejected.
properties.notes: Central aggregation point for all chain roots.

properties.property: ACTION-HUB-RECEIVE-ROOT validates source EID corresponds to a registered Verifier before accepting the transfer root payload.
properties.anti_property: Hub accepts a root from an unauthorized LayerZero endpoint, poisoning the aggregation tree.
properties.reachability_rationale: EID validation against registered peer list is performed before payload processing. Unknown EIDs cause message rejection.
properties.notes: CRITICAL: Source validation prevents root injection attacks.

properties.property: ACTION-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT stores the validated root in transferRoots[tokenIndex] mapping.
properties.anti_property: Root update overwrites a valid root with a lower tree index (rollback attack).
properties.reachability_rationale: Root updates are indexed by token. New roots add to the tree rather than replacing. Monotonic tree index prevents rollback.
properties.notes: Per-token root tracking with monotonic indices.

properties.property: STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED indicates successful storage of a new transfer root. TransferRootUpdated event emitted.
properties.anti_property: STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED is reached without valid EID validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge from ACTION-HUB-RECEIVE-ROOT passes through EID validation before reaching ACTION-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT.

properties.property: STATE-AWAITING-BROADCAST holds updated roots until broadcast() is triggered to compute and send aggregation root.
properties.anti_property: Broadcast occurs with stale or incomplete root data.
properties.reachability_rationale: Broadcast reads current transferRoots state at call time. All updates prior to broadcast are included in aggregation.

properties.property: ACTION-HUB-COMPUTE-AGGREGATION builds PoseidonT3 tree of height 6 over all registered token roots (max 64 tokens).
properties.anti_property: Aggregation tree is computed incorrectly, resulting in a root that doesn't match the actual token roots.
properties.reachability_rationale: PoseidonT3 computation is deterministic. The same inputs always produce the same root. Implementation must match circom-compatible configuration.
properties.notes: Aggregation tree enables efficient global inclusion proofs.

properties.property: ACTION-HUB-INCREMENT-AGG-SEQ increments aggSeq counter monotonically for each broadcast.
properties.anti_property: Aggregation sequence number is reused, allowing replay of old global roots.
properties.reachability_rationale: aggSeq is a counter variable that only increments. Solidity storage semantics prevent decrement without explicit code.

properties.property: ACTION-HUB-BROADCAST-ROOT sends the aggregation root to all registered Verifiers via LayerZero.
properties.anti_property: Some Verifiers don't receive the broadcast, creating inconsistent global state.
properties.reachability_rationale: LayerZero delivery is eventual but not guaranteed atomic across all chains. Retry mechanisms and monitoring mitigate delivery failures.

properties.property: STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST indicates the Hub has successfully initiated global root distribution.
properties.anti_property: Hub reaches broadcast state but no LayerZero messages are actually sent.
properties.reachability_rationale: The broadcast function iterates over registered endpoints and calls _lzSend for each. State transition occurs after all sends complete.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT validates source EID is authorized Hub before storing global root.
properties.anti_property: Verifier accepts a global root from unauthorized source, enabling fake cross-chain teleports.
properties.reachability_rationale: The Verifier's _lzReceive validates source EID against hubEid. Messages from other endpoints are rejected.
properties.notes: CRITICAL: Prevents global root injection attacks.

properties.property: STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED indicates Verifier has stored the global root in globalTransferRoots mapping for cross-chain teleports.
properties.anti_property: STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED is reached with a root that wasn't sent by the authorized Hub.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge to STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED only exists from ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT which performs Hub EID validation.
properties.notes: Terminal state for global root reception.

properties.property: STATE-INDEXER-IDLE represents semi-trusted Indexer service ready to process events.
properties.anti_property: Indexer provides data to users without proper event watching.
properties.reachability_rationale: Indexer follows blockchain events deterministically. Off-chain service state is managed by service implementation.
properties.notes: Semi-trusted service - proofs are verified on-chain.

properties.property: ACTION-INDEXER-WATCH-EVENTS subscribes to IndexedTransfer events from trusted zERC20 contract.
properties.anti_property: Indexer processes events from a malicious contract that emits fake IndexedTransfer events.
properties.reachability_rationale: Indexer must be configured with correct zERC20 contract address. Misconfiguration could lead to fake events. Proofs generated from fake events will fail on-chain verification.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: On-chain Merkle root verification catches fabricated proofs

properties.property: ACTION-INDEXER-BUILD-TREE constructs Merkle tree from IndexedTransfer events in correct order.
properties.anti_property: Indexer builds tree with events out of order or with missing events, producing wrong root.
properties.reachability_rationale: Indexer is semi-trusted. Incorrect tree construction would produce Merkle proofs that fail on-chain verification against the canonical root stored in zERC20.
properties.notes: Semi-trusted service with cryptographic verification safety net.

properties.property: STATE-INDEXER-TREE-READY indicates Merkle tree is synchronized with on-chain events and ready to serve proofs.
properties.anti_property: Indexer serves proofs from a stale or incorrect tree state.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stale proofs may fail to include recent transfers but won't compromise security - they'll simply fail to verify if the root has changed.
properties.notes: Liveness concern rather than security concern.

properties.property: ACTION-INDEXER-GENERATE-PROOFS produces valid Merkle inclusion proofs that verify against the on-chain root.
properties.anti_property: Generated proofs fail on-chain verification despite correct tree construction.
properties.reachability_rationale: Merkle proof generation is deterministic. Given correct tree state, proofs will verify. Any mismatch indicates implementation bug, not attack.

properties.property: STATE-PROVER-IDLE represents Decider/Prover service ready to receive Nova IVC proofs for Groth16 conversion.
properties.anti_property: Prover service accepts jobs from unauthorized sources or processes malformed inputs.
properties.reachability_rationale: Prover is semi-trusted service. Malformed inputs would fail deserialization or produce invalid Groth16 proofs that fail on-chain verification.

properties.property: ACTION-PROVER-RECEIVE-IVC validates and deserializes the received Nova IVC proof before processing.
properties.anti_property: Prover processes malformed IVC proof, wasting compute resources or producing garbage output.
properties.reachability_rationale: Deserialization validates proof structure. Malformed proofs fail early. Invalid but well-formed proofs fail local IVC verification before Groth16 conversion.

properties.property: STATE-JOB-QUEUED indicates a valid proof conversion job has been accepted and awaits processing.
properties.anti_property: Jobs are lost from the queue before processing.
properties.reachability_rationale: Queue persistence is service implementation concern. Job loss would require user to resubmit but doesn't affect security.

properties.property: STATE-JOB-PROCESSING indicates active Nova to Groth16 conversion is in progress.
properties.anti_property: Processing state is reached without valid queued job.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge to STATE-JOB-PROCESSING only exists from STATE-JOB-QUEUED. No path bypasses the queue.

properties.property: ACTION-PROVER-CONVERT-TO-GROTH16 correctly transforms valid Nova IVC proof into Groth16 proof that verifies on-chain.
properties.anti_property: Prover produces Groth16 proof that passes on-chain verification but doesn't correspond to the original IVC proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: The Groth16 proof is generated from the IVC accumulator using the same circuit. Mathematical soundness ensures the converted proof maintains the same public inputs and validity.

properties.property: STATE-JOB-COMPLETED indicates successful Groth16 proof generation ready for user retrieval.
properties.anti_property: Job is marked completed but proof is invalid or unavailable for retrieval.
properties.reachability_rationale: Completion only occurs after successful proof generation and storage. Proof availability is service implementation concern.

properties.property: STATE-JOB-FAILED correctly indicates conversion failure (invalid IVC, computation error).
properties.anti_property: Valid jobs are incorrectly marked as failed.
properties.reachability_rationale: Failure only occurs when IVC verification or Groth16 generation fails. Valid proofs complete successfully.

properties.property: STATE-ADAPTOR-IDLE represents Adaptor contract ready to process cross-chain bridge requests.
properties.anti_property: Adaptor processes requests while in invalid state.
properties.reachability_rationale: Contract state is managed by Solidity. The Adaptor has no complex state machine beyond function execution.

properties.property: ACTION-ADAPTOR-RECEIVE-UNWRAP-BRIDGE validates user has sufficient zERC20 and bridge parameters are valid.
properties.anti_property: Bridge request proceeds with insufficient user balance or invalid destination parameters.
properties.reachability_rationale: Balance check occurs during unwrap. Invalid bridge params cause Stargate call to revert. Both validations prevent invalid requests from completing.

properties.property: ACTION-ADAPTOR-UNWRAP-VIA-LM unwraps user's zERC20 via LiquidityManager before bridging underlying.
properties.anti_property: Adaptor bridges underlying without first burning user's zERC20.
properties.reachability_rationale: The Adaptor calls LiquidityManager.unwrap() which performs burn atomically. Bridging only occurs with unwrapped underlying.

properties.property: ACTION-ADAPTOR-BRIDGE-VIA-STARGATE sends underlying tokens to Stargate with slippage protection (minAmountOut).
properties.anti_property: Bridge executes with slippage exceeding user's tolerance, resulting in excessive fund loss.
properties.reachability_rationale: minAmountOut parameter is set by user or Adaptor. Stargate bridge will revert if output is below minimum.

properties.property: STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED indicates successful Stargate bridge initiation with UnwrapAndBridge event emitted.
properties.anti_property: STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED is reached but no Stargate message was sent.
properties.reachability_rationale: State transition follows successful Stargate.send() call. Event emission and state are atomic within transaction.
properties.notes: Terminal success state for bridge initiation.

properties.property: STATE-BRIDGE-FAILED indicates Stargate bridge failure with appropriate error handling.
properties.anti_property: Bridge failure leaves user without zERC20 and without underlying (fund loss).
properties.reachability_rationale: If Stargate revert occurs after unwrap, user has underlying in Adaptor. Refund mechanisms should return funds. However, implementation must handle this correctly.
properties.notes: Error handling is critical - potential fund loss scenario.

properties.property: ACTION-USER-GENERATE-STEALTH derives stealth burn address locally using PoW and cryptographic functions.
properties.anti_property: Stealth address generation is predictable or reversible, compromising privacy.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stealth address derivation uses keccak256 and BN254 operations. Secret knowledge is required to link address to owner.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: keccak256 preimage resistance, Baby JubJub discrete log hardness

properties.property: ACTION-USER-GENERATE-NOVA-PROOF generates valid Nova IVC proof locally proving ownership of burned tokens.
properties.anti_property: User generates proof without actually owning the burned tokens (proof forgery).
properties.reachability_rationale: Nova circuit requires valid Merkle proofs and secrets as witness. Without secret knowledge of burns, proof generation fails.
properties.notes: Client-side proof generation with ZK soundness.

properties.property: STATE-USER-HAS-NOVA-PROOF indicates user has generated valid local IVC proof ready for conversion.
properties.anti_property: User reaches this state with an invalid IVC proof that will fail conversion.
properties.reachability_rationale: Local proof generation includes verification step. Invalid proofs fail locally before user proceeds.
properties.notes: Local verification catches invalid proofs early.

properties.property: ACTION-USER-SUBMIT-TO-PROVER submits base64-encoded IVC proof to semi-trusted Decider/Prover service.
properties.anti_property: Submission exposes private information beyond what's necessary for conversion.
properties.reachability_rationale: IVC proof contains only public inputs and cryptographic commitments. Private witness data (secrets) is not included in the submission.

properties.property: STATE-USER-HAS-GROTH16-PROOF indicates user has retrieved valid Groth16 proof ready for on-chain submission.
properties.anti_property: User has Groth16 proof that will fail on-chain verification.
properties.reachability_rationale: Prover service generates proof using correct circuit and verification key. User can locally verify before submission.

properties.property: ACTION-USER-SUBMIT-TELEPORT sends teleport transaction with Groth16 proof to Verifier contract.
properties.anti_property: Teleport submission is front-run, allowing attacker to claim user's funds.
properties.reachability_rationale: The proof commits to specific recipient (msg.sender). Front-runner cannot change recipient without invalidating proof.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Recipient binding in proof public inputs

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-ROTATE-VERIFIERS updates verifier addresses via onlyOwner-restricted function.
properties.anti_property: Non-owner can rotate verifiers, enabling malicious verifier installation.
properties.reachability_rationale: The onlyOwner modifier restricts access. Only owner EOA or multisig can call setVerifiers().
properties.notes: Admin key security is external dependency.

properties.property: ACTION-VERIFIER-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY restores normal operation after emergency via owner action.
properties.anti_property: Emergency state is deactivated before underlying issue is resolved.
properties.reachability_rationale: Owner can deactivate emergency at any time. This is accepted risk as it requires trust in owner to act responsibly.
properties.notes: Admin trust assumption - owner must verify safety before deactivation.

properties.property: STATE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED indicates successful return to normal operation after emergency handling.
properties.anti_property: Recovery is declared but system remains in compromised state.
properties.reachability_rationale: Recovery state transition is owner-controlled. Proper recovery requires off-chain analysis and decision-making.
properties.notes: Recovery correctness depends on off-chain governance.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-INITIATES-WRAP is a trust boundary crossing where untrusted user submits wrap request to trusted LiquidityManager.
properties.anti_property: Malicious wrap request bypasses validation and directly triggers minting.
properties.reachability_rationale: All wrap requests enter through the wrap() function which enforces amount validation, transferFrom for underlying, and reward calculation before minting.

properties.property: EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-REWARD transition triggers incentive curve calculation with floor rounding.
properties.anti_property: Reward calculation is skipped or manipulated during this transition.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge is traversed atomically within the wrap() function. No external input affects the calculation path.

properties.property: EDGE-LM-PULLS-LIQUIDITY requires successful transferFrom of underlying tokens before proceeding.
properties.anti_property: Edge is traversed without underlying tokens being transferred.
properties.reachability_rationale: transferFrom reverts on insufficient balance/allowance. The edge can only be traversed if transferFrom succeeds.

properties.property: EDGE-LM-MINTS-ZERC20 triggers minting only after liquidity is successfully pulled.
properties.anti_property: Minting occurs before or without liquidity pull.
properties.reachability_rationale: The sequential edge structure enforces order. ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20 can only be reached from ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY.

properties.property: EDGE-WRAP-COMPLETE transition emits Wrapped event after successful mint.
properties.anti_property: Wrap completes without event emission.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event emission is atomic with state transition. Solidity guarantees events are emitted within successful transactions.
properties.notes: Event emission is verifiable via logs.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-ZERC20 is trust boundary where trusted LiquidityManager mints tokens to untrusted user.
properties.anti_property: Tokens are minted to wrong recipient or in wrong amount.
properties.reachability_rationale: Mint recipient is the msg.sender of wrap(). Amount is (wrap amount + calculated reward). Both are deterministic.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-INITIATES-UNWRAP is trust boundary where untrusted user submits unwrap request.
properties.anti_property: User unwraps more zERC20 than they own.
properties.reachability_rationale: The burn operation in unwrap checks user's zERC20 balance. Attempting to burn more than owned reverts.

properties.property: EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-FEE triggers fee calculation with ceiling rounding (protocol protection).
properties.anti_property: Fee calculation is bypassed or uses wrong rounding.
properties.reachability_rationale: Fee calculation is mandatory in unwrap flow. IncentiveLib.computeFee uses ceiling rounding by design.
properties.notes: Ceiling rounding protects protocol from undercollection.

properties.property: EDGE-LM-BURNS-ZERC20 triggers burn after fee calculation, before underlying transfer.
properties.anti_property: Burn is skipped or delayed after underlying transfer (double-spend risk).
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge order is fixed: fee calculation -> burn -> transfer. No path allows transfer before burn.
properties.notes: Order is critical for reentrancy protection.

properties.property: EDGE-LM-TRANSFERS-UNDERLYING transfers exactly (amount - fee) after burn.
properties.anti_property: User receives more underlying than (burned amount - fee).
properties.reachability_rationale: Transfer amount is computed deterministically. No user input affects the final transfer amount after fee calculation.
properties.notes: Final step sends underlying to user.

properties.property: EDGE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE emits Unwrapped event after successful underlying transfer.
properties.anti_property: Unwrap completes without event or with incorrect event data.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event emission is atomic with function completion. Event parameters match actual transferred amounts.

properties.property: EDGE-UNWRAP-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY correctly routes to failure when liquidity is insufficient.
properties.anti_property: Insufficient liquidity is not detected, leading to failed underlying transfer.
properties.reachability_rationale: Liquidity check compares requested amount against (underlyingBalance - feeSurplus). Arithmetic is straightforward.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-UNDERLYING is trust boundary where LiquidityManager sends underlying to untrusted user.
properties.anti_property: Underlying sent to wrong address or in wrong amount.
properties.reachability_rationale: Transfer recipient is msg.sender (or specified recipient). Amount is deterministically computed.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-INITIATES-TRANSFER is trust boundary where user initiates zERC20 transfer.
properties.anti_property: Transfer bypasses value validation or hash chain update.
properties.reachability_rationale: The transfer() function calls _afterTokenTransfer hook which enforces value validation and hash chain update.

properties.property: EDGE-ZERC20-VALIDATES-VALUE triggers BN254 field constraint check.
properties.anti_property: Value validation is bypassed for oversized values.
properties.reachability_rationale: The _afterTokenTransfer hook is called for every transfer by OpenZeppelin ERC20. Cannot be bypassed.

properties.property: EDGE-VALUE-TOO-LARGE correctly reverts transfers exceeding 2^248-1.
properties.anti_property: Oversized transfer proceeds instead of reverting.
properties.reachability_rationale: The comparison (value > MAX_VALUE) deterministically triggers revert for oversized values.

properties.property: EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-BALANCES only traversed for valid values.
properties.anti_property: Balance update occurs for invalid value.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge only exists from the success path of value validation. Failed validation reverts.

properties.property: EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-HASH-CHAIN appends (to, value) to hash chain after balance update.
properties.anti_property: Hash chain update is skipped or uses wrong data.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hash chain update is mandatory in _afterTokenTransfer. Uses actual transfer parameters, not user input.

properties.property: EDGE-ZERC20-EMITS-EVENT emits IndexedTransfer with monotonically increasing index.
properties.anti_property: Event has duplicate index or wrong transfer data.
properties.reachability_rationale: Index counter is storage variable incremented atomically. Single-threaded execution prevents races.

properties.property: EDGE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE finalizes transfer after all steps complete.
properties.anti_property: Transfer marked complete with incomplete hash chain or missing event.
properties.reachability_rationale: Transaction atomicity ensures all steps complete or none do. STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE is the final state.

properties.property: EDGE-INDEXER-WATCHES initiates event subscription from trusted contract.
properties.anti_property: Indexer watches wrong contract or misses events.
properties.reachability_rationale: Indexer configuration is operational. Misconfiguration would produce invalid proofs that fail on-chain verification.
properties.notes: Semi-trusted service with on-chain verification safety net.

properties.property: EDGE-INDEXER-EVENT-RECEIVED is trust boundary where trusted zERC20 sends event to semi-trusted Indexer.
properties.anti_property: Indexer processes fake events not from zERC20 contract.
properties.reachability_rationale: Indexer must be configured with correct contract address. Fake events would produce Merkle proofs that fail on-chain root comparison.

properties.property: EDGE-INDEXER-TREE-UPDATED correctly extends Merkle tree with new leaf.
properties.anti_property: Tree update produces incorrect root or corrupts existing structure.
properties.reachability_rationale: Merkle tree construction is deterministic. Incorrect construction produces proofs that fail on-chain verification.

properties.property: EDGE-INDEXER-GENERATES-PROOF produces valid Merkle inclusion proof for requested leaf.
properties.anti_property: Generated proof is invalid or for wrong leaf.
properties.reachability_rationale: Proof generation from correct tree is deterministic. Wrong proofs fail on-chain verification.

properties.property: EDGE-VERIFIER-RESERVES-CHECKPOINT allows untrusted caller to trigger checkpoint reservation on trusted Verifier.
properties.anti_property: Caller supplies fake hash chain value instead of Verifier reading from zERC20.
properties.reachability_rationale: Verifier reads hashChain from zERC20 contract directly, ignoring any user-provided values. The trusted source is hardcoded.

properties.property: EDGE-CHECKPOINT-RESERVED stores authentic hash chain state with HashChainReserved event.
properties.anti_property: Checkpoint is stored with incorrect hash chain value.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hash chain is read from trusted source (zERC20) and stored directly. No transformation or user input affects stored value.

properties.property: EDGE-AWAITING-NOVA-PROOF transitions to proof acceptance state after checkpoint.
properties.anti_property: Proof acceptance state reached without valid checkpoint.
properties.reachability_rationale: Sequential dependency - proof submission checks checkpoint existence. No path exists without prior checkpoint.

properties.property: EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-SUBMITTED is trust boundary where untrusted user submits Nova proof to trusted Verifier.
properties.anti_property: Invalid proof is accepted without cryptographic verification.
properties.reachability_rationale: All submitted proofs undergo IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof() cryptographic verification. Invalid proofs are rejected.
properties.notes: CRITICAL BOUNDARY EDGE: User->Verifier proof submission.

properties.property: EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-VALID only traversed after successful cryptographic verification.
properties.anti_property: Edge traversed for invalid proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge exists only for successful verification. Failed verification causes revert or emergency trigger.

properties.property: EDGE-DIVERGENT-PROOF-DETECTED triggers emergency when conflicting roots are proved for same index.
properties.anti_property: Divergent proofs are silently accepted, leading to protocol inconsistency.
properties.reachability_rationale: Divergent proof detection compares new root against existing. Detection triggers emergency, not silent acceptance.

properties.property: EDGE-VERIFIER-RELAYS-ROOT sends proved root to Hub via LayerZero from trusted Verifier.
properties.anti_property: Unproved root is relayed to Hub.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge only exists from STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED, which requires prior proof verification.

properties.property: EDGE-ROOT-RELAYED confirms LayerZero message submission.
properties.anti_property: Relay appears complete but message not submitted.
properties.reachability_rationale: _lzSend call either succeeds or reverts. State transition only on success.

properties.property: EDGE-HUB-RECEIVES-ROOT is trust boundary where semi-trusted LayerZero delivers to trusted Hub.
properties.anti_property: Hub accepts root from unauthorized LayerZero endpoint.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hub's _lzReceive validates source EID against registered Verifier list. Unknown EIDs are rejected.
properties.notes: CRITICAL BOUNDARY EDGE: LayerZero->Hub trust transition.

properties.property: EDGE-HUB-UPDATES-ROOT stores validated root after EID verification.
properties.anti_property: Root stored without EID validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: EID validation is first step in _lzReceive. Storage update only occurs after validation passes.

properties.property: EDGE-ROOT-STORED emits TransferRootUpdated event after storage.
properties.anti_property: Root stored without event emission.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event emission is atomic with storage operation. Solidity guarantees event logging on successful execution.

properties.property: EDGE-AWAITING-BROADCAST transitions to broadcast-ready state.
properties.anti_property: Broadcast occurs immediately without waiting for aggregation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Root updates and broadcasts are separate functions. No automatic broadcast on update.

properties.property: EDGE-BROADCAST-TRIGGERED initiates aggregation tree computation.
properties.anti_property: Broadcast uses stale or incorrect root data.
properties.reachability_rationale: Aggregation reads current transferRoots storage at call time. Fresh data is always used.

properties.property: EDGE-AGGREGATION-COMPUTED produces correct PoseidonT3 tree root.
properties.anti_property: Aggregation produces incorrect root.
properties.reachability_rationale: PoseidonT3 is deterministic. Same inputs always produce same output. Implementation must match circom configuration.

properties.property: EDGE-AGG-SEQ-INCREMENTED advances sequence counter monotonically.
properties.anti_property: Sequence counter is reused or decremented.
properties.reachability_rationale: Counter increment is unchecked (overflow at 2^256 is acceptable) and always increases. No decrement operation exists.

properties.property: EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SENT broadcasts aggregation root to all Verifiers via LayerZero.
properties.anti_property: Broadcast misses some Verifiers or sends wrong root.
properties.reachability_rationale: Broadcast iterates over all registered endpoints. LayerZero delivery is eventual but not guaranteed atomic.

properties.property: EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-GLOBAL delivers global root from Hub via LayerZero to Verifier.
properties.anti_property: Verifier accepts global root from non-Hub source.
properties.reachability_rationale: Verifier's _lzReceive validates source EID matches hubEid before processing. Non-Hub messages are rejected.
properties.notes: CRITICAL BOUNDARY EDGE: LayerZero->Verifier global root.

properties.property: EDGE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED stores global root after Hub EID validation with event.
properties.anti_property: Global root stored without validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hub EID validation is prerequisite. Storage and event occur atomically after validation.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-GENERATES-STEALTH initiates local stealth address generation.
properties.anti_property: Stealth generation leaks private information to external parties.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stealth generation is entirely local (client-side). No network communication during generation.

properties.property: EDGE-STEALTH-GENERATED produces valid stealth address with PoW.
properties.anti_property: Generated address fails PoW validation.
properties.reachability_rationale: PoW nonce search continues until valid nonce found. Generation only completes with valid address.

properties.property: EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-GENERATED produces valid IVC proof from historical transfers.
properties.anti_property: Generated proof is invalid or doesn't match user's burns.
properties.reachability_rationale: Nova circuit requires valid witnesses. Invalid inputs fail circuit satisfaction. Local verification catches errors.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TO-PROVER is trust boundary where untrusted user submits IVC to semi-trusted Prover.
properties.anti_property: Submission exposes user's private information beyond proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: IVC proof contains only public inputs and cryptographic commitments. Private witness (secrets) is not transmitted.

properties.property: EDGE-PROVER-RECEIVES-IVC validates IVC format before processing.
properties.anti_property: Malformed IVC consumes resources or produces garbage output.
properties.reachability_rationale: Deserialization validates structure. Invalid format fails early. Local IVC verification catches invalid proofs.

properties.property: EDGE-JOB-QUEUED creates conversion job after successful IVC reception.
properties.anti_property: Job created for invalid IVC.
properties.reachability_rationale: Queueing only occurs after IVC validation. Invalid proofs are rejected before queueing.

properties.property: EDGE-JOB-STARTS-PROCESSING picks up queued job for conversion.
properties.anti_property: Job processing starts with corrupted queue data.
properties.reachability_rationale: Job data is read from queue as stored. Queue integrity is service implementation concern.

properties.property: EDGE-PROVER-CONVERTS initiates Nova to Groth16 transformation.
properties.anti_property: Conversion uses wrong circuit parameters.
properties.reachability_rationale: Circuit parameters are loaded from trusted configuration. Same parameters used for all conversions.

properties.property: EDGE-JOB-COMPLETED stores valid Groth16 proof after successful conversion.
properties.anti_property: Invalid Groth16 proof marked as completed.
properties.reachability_rationale: Conversion either produces valid proof or fails. Completion only on valid output.

properties.property: EDGE-JOB-FAILED correctly reports conversion failure.
properties.anti_property: Valid conversion incorrectly marked as failed.
properties.reachability_rationale: Failure only occurs on actual conversion error. Deterministic process prevents random failures.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-RETRIEVES-GROTH16 is trust boundary where semi-trusted Prover sends proof to untrusted user.
properties.anti_property: User receives wrong proof or proof for another user.
properties.reachability_rationale: Proof retrieval is keyed by job ID from submission. User can only retrieve their own proofs. Verification on-chain catches any mismatch.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-TELEPORT is trust boundary where untrusted user submits teleport with proof.
properties.anti_property: Teleport submission is front-run, claiming user's funds.
properties.reachability_rationale: Proof commits to specific recipient (msg.sender). Front-runner cannot change recipient without invalidating proof.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: Recipient binding in proof public inputs

properties.property: EDGE-VERIFIER-RECEIVES-TELEPORT receives teleport request for full validation chain.
properties.anti_property: Teleport accepted without all four validations.
properties.reachability_rationale: All teleport paths go through: root validation -> recipient hash -> monotonicity -> proof verification. No shortcut exists.

properties.property: EDGE-VALIDATE-ROOT-REF checks root exists in proved or global roots mapping.
properties.anti_property: Validation passes for non-existent root.
properties.reachability_rationale: Mapping lookup returns zero for non-existent keys. Comparison with user-provided root fails for fabricated values.

properties.property: EDGE-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH verifies recipient matches proof commitment.
properties.anti_property: Funds sent to wrong recipient.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hash of claimed recipient is computed on-chain and compared with proof public input. Mismatch causes revert.

properties.property: EDGE-CHECK-MONOTONICITY enforces strictly increasing totalTeleported.
properties.anti_property: Same proof used multiple times (replay attack).
properties.reachability_rationale: Proof's totalTeleported must exceed stored value. Replay has equal value, causing revert.

properties.property: EDGE-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF performs cryptographic proof verification.
properties.anti_property: Invalid proof passes verification.
properties.reachability_rationale: Groth16 pairing check is sound. Invalid proofs fail with overwhelming probability.

properties.property: EDGE-PROOF-VALID-CALL-TELEPORT calls zERC20.teleport() only after all validations.
properties.anti_property: teleport() called before all validations complete.
properties.reachability_rationale: The edge only exists from successful withdrawal proof validation, which requires prior validations.

properties.property: EDGE-TELEPORT-MINTED mints exact delta amount to verified recipient.
properties.anti_property: Wrong amount minted or to wrong recipient.
properties.reachability_rationale: Amount and recipient are extracted from verified proof public inputs. No user input affects final values.

properties.property: EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-INVALID-ROOT correctly rejects unknown root references.
properties.anti_property: Valid root incorrectly rejected.
properties.reachability_rationale: Root lookup is deterministic. Existing roots always found; non-existent always fail.

properties.property: EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-BAD-RECIPIENT rejects recipient hash mismatches.
properties.anti_property: Mismatch not detected, funds go to wrong address.
properties.reachability_rationale: Hash comparison is deterministic. Mismatches always detected.

properties.property: EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-DOUBLE-SPEND blocks replay attempts.
properties.anti_property: Replay not detected, double-minting occurs.
properties.reachability_rationale: Monotonicity check is strict inequality. Replay has equal totalTeleported, guaranteed rejection.

properties.property: EDGE-TELEPORT-REJECTED-INVALID-PROOF rejects cryptographically invalid proofs.
properties.anti_property: Invalid proof passes verification.
properties.reachability_rationale: Groth16 pairing check deterministically identifies invalid proofs.

properties.property: EDGE-USER-INITIATES-BRIDGE is trust boundary for cross-chain exit.
properties.anti_property: Bridge initiated without sufficient user balance.
properties.reachability_rationale: Unwrap step checks balance. Insufficient balance causes revert before bridging.

properties.property: EDGE-ADAPTOR-RECEIVES-REQUEST validates bridge parameters.
properties.anti_property: Invalid bridge params cause fund loss.
properties.reachability_rationale: Stargate validates parameters. Invalid params cause revert. Slippage protection prevents excessive loss.

properties.property: EDGE-ADAPTOR-UNWRAPS unwraps zERC20 before bridging.
properties.anti_property: Bridge uses underlying without burning zERC20.
properties.reachability_rationale: Adaptor calls LiquidityManager.unwrap() which burns zERC20. No path to bridge without unwrap.

properties.property: EDGE-ADAPTOR-BRIDGES sends underlying via Stargate with slippage protection.
properties.anti_property: Excessive slippage causes user fund loss.
properties.reachability_rationale: minAmountOut parameter enforces slippage limit. Stargate reverts if output below minimum.

properties.property: EDGE-BRIDGE-INITIATED emits UnwrapAndBridge event after Stargate send.
properties.anti_property: Bridge initiated without event.
properties.reachability_rationale: Event emission is atomic with Stargate.send() success.

properties.property: EDGE-BRIDGE-FAILED handles Stargate failure appropriately.
properties.anti_property: Failure leaves user without zERC20 or underlying.
properties.reachability_rationale: If Stargate fails after unwrap, user has underlying in Adaptor. Refund mechanism should handle this. Implementation must be careful.
properties.notes: Error handling path - potential fund risk.

properties.property: EDGE-EMERGENCY-ROTATE-VERIFIERS is admin action during emergency.
properties.anti_property: Verifiers rotated by non-owner.
properties.reachability_rationale: onlyOwner modifier restricts access. Only owner can call setVerifiers().

properties.property: EDGE-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY is admin action to restore normal operation.
properties.anti_property: Emergency deactivated without resolving issue.
properties.reachability_rationale: Owner can deactivate at any time. Accepted risk - requires trust in admin judgment.

properties.property: EDGE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED transitions to recovered state.
properties.anti_property: Recovery declared while system compromised.
properties.reachability_rationale: Recovery is owner's judgment call. Accepted trust assumption.

properties.property: EDGE-BACK-TO-IDLE returns Verifier to normal operation.
properties.anti_property: Return to idle without proper recovery.
properties.reachability_rationale: Transition only from STATE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED, which requires admin deactivation.

properties.property: GRAPH-NOVA-PROOF-GENERATION produces valid Nova IVC proofs from historical transfer data.
properties.anti_property: Proof generation creates invalid proofs or leaks private information.
properties.reachability_rationale: Nova folding scheme provides soundness (invalid witness fails) and zero-knowledge (private data not leaked). Local verification catches errors before submission.

properties.property: GRAPH-NOVA-TO-GROTH16 correctly converts IVC proofs to Groth16 format for on-chain verification.
properties.anti_property: Conversion produces Groth16 proof that verifies but doesn't match original IVC proof.
properties.reachability_rationale: Groth16 proof is generated from the same circuit with same public inputs. Mathematical equivalence ensures proof correspondence.

properties.property: GRAPH-NOVA-PROOF-VERIFICATION performs complete on-chain verification of transfer root proofs.
properties.anti_property: Verification accepts invalid proof or stores unverified root.
properties.reachability_rationale: IRootDecider performs cryptographic verification. Invalid proofs fail pairing check. Storage only after successful verification.
properties.notes: Sub-graph covering on-chain root proof verification.

properties.property: GRAPH-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF-VERIFICATION verifies withdrawal proofs for teleport operations.
properties.anti_property: Invalid withdrawal proof passes, enabling unauthorized minting.
properties.reachability_rationale: Both Nova and Groth16 paths perform cryptographic verification. Invalid proofs fail with overwhelming probability.

properties.property: GRAPH-INCENTIVE-CURVE correctly computes incentives using linear density integration with proper rounding.
properties.anti_property: Incentive calculation produces incorrect values enabling reward/fee manipulation.
properties.reachability_rationale: Mathematical formula is deterministic. Floor rounding for rewards, ceiling for fees protects protocol.

properties.property: GRAPH-HUB-AGGREGATION computes correct PoseidonT3 aggregation tree from token roots.
properties.anti_property: Aggregation produces incorrect root that doesn't match token roots.
properties.reachability_rationale: PoseidonT3 is deterministic. Same inputs produce same output. Circom-compatible configuration ensures circuit compatibility.
properties.notes: Sub-graph covering Hub aggregation tree computation.

properties.property: GRAPH-LAYERZERO-MESSAGE-FLOW delivers cross-chain messages with EID validation.
properties.anti_property: Message from unauthorized source is accepted by receiver.
properties.reachability_rationale: EID validation on receiver rejects unknown sources. Guardian supermajority provides message integrity.

properties.property: GRAPH-STEALTH-ADDRESS-GENERATION produces unlinkable stealth addresses with PoW.
properties.anti_property: Stealth addresses are linkable to original sender or predictable.
properties.reachability_rationale: keccak256 and Baby JubJub operations provide unlinkability. Without secret knowledge, addresses cannot be linked to sender.
properties.cryptographic_guarantee: keccak256 preimage resistance, Baby JubJub discrete log hardness

properties.property: GRAPH-POSEIDON-HASH-CIRCUIT computes circom-compatible Poseidon hashes.
properties.anti_property: Hash output differs from circom implementation, breaking ZK circuit compatibility.
properties.reachability_rationale: Configuration matches light-poseidon circom-compatible settings. Same parameters produce same output as circom.

properties.property: GRAPH-BABY-JUBJUB-OPERATIONS performs correct elliptic curve operations on Baby JubJub.
properties.anti_property: Curve operations produce incorrect results or leak private scalars.
properties.reachability_rationale: Curve arithmetic is deterministic. Point validation ensures operations on valid curve points. Discrete log hardness protects private scalars.
properties.notes: Sub-graph covering Baby JubJub curve operations.

properties.property: GRAPH-IC-CANISTER-INTERACTION securely manages encrypted state via IC canisters.
properties.anti_property: Plaintext state is exposed to IC canisters or unauthorized parties.
properties.reachability_rationale: AES-GCM encryption protects plaintext. VetKey derivation ensures only authorized users can derive encryption keys.

properties.property: GRAPH-STARGATE-BRIDGE-FLOW bridges assets with slippage protection.
properties.anti_property: Bridge executes with excessive slippage causing user fund loss.
properties.reachability_rationale: minAmountOut parameter is validated. Stargate reverts on slippage exceeded. Refund mechanism handles failures.

properties.property: GRAPH-NOVA-FOLDING-SCHEME correctly implements Nova IVC with proper accumulator updates.
properties.anti_property: Folding produces invalid IVC proof or incorrect state transitions.
properties.reachability_rationale: Nova folding scheme provides IVC soundness. Invalid witnesses fail circuit satisfaction. Local verification catches errors.
properties.notes: Sub-graph covering Nova folding scheme details.

properties.property: GRAPH-SELFCALL-PATTERN prevents external reentrancy via controlled self-call mechanism.
properties.anti_property: External caller bypasses onlySelfCall protection.
properties.reachability_rationale: onlySelfCall modifier requires both msg.sender == address(this) AND context flag set. External callers fail both conditions.

properties.property: GRAPH-NATIVE-TOKEN-HANDLING correctly processes ETH with proper validation and WETH wrapping.
properties.anti_property: ETH gets stuck in contract or msg.value validation fails.
properties.reachability_rationale: msg.value validation ensures expected amount. WETH wrapping is standard operation. Excess ETH is refunded.

properties.property: GRAPH-GOVERNANCE-ADMIN-FUNCTIONS restricts administrative actions to owner only.
properties.anti_property: Non-owner performs administrative actions.
properties.reachability_rationale: All admin functions have onlyOwner modifier. Non-owner calls revert.
properties.notes: Sub-graph covering admin functions. Note: No timelock - immediate effect.

properties.property: GRAPH-STARGATE-LZCOMPOSE-CALLBACK validates caller and origin before processing compose messages.
properties.anti_property: Compose callback accepts message from unauthorized source.
properties.reachability_rationale: Caller validation requires msg.sender == LayerZero endpoint. Origin validation requires _from in registered Stargate pools.
